release_notes: Build 146 fixes scheduled-quiz counts so future YouTube schedules are not limited to the newest 2,000 history rows.
Autopilot schedule target and the dashboard Scheduled count now use a dedicated future-schedule database query that does not scan project folders.
YouTube status refresh preserves a known future schedule when the API temporarily omits publishAt, while still clearing it when YouTube confirms the video is public.
Directory path changes remain isolated from YouTube scheduling metadata and no recursive path scan was reintroduced.
